questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to acquire knowledge?
explanation: Learn is correct - L-E-A-R-N. Learn means to gain knowledge or skill.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a lot?
explanation: A lot is correct - A L-O-T. A lot means a great deal or a large amount. It is always two separate words.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning taking place?
explanation: Occurring is correct - O-C-C-U-R-R-I-N-G. Occurring has double C and double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to get?
explanation: Receive is correct - R-E-C-E-I-V-E. Remember: I before E except after C.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the day after today?
explanation: Tomorrow is correct - T-O-M-O-R-R-O-W. Tomorrow has one M and double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning something that cannot be done?
explanation: Impossible is correct - I-M-P-O-S-S-I-B-L-E. Impossible has double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very helpful?
explanation: Useful is correct - U-S-E-F-U-L. Useful has only one L at the end.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word for definitely?
explanation: Definitely is correct - D-E-F-I-N-I-T-E-L-Y. Definitely is one of the most commonly misspelled words.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning two separate groups?
explanation: Separate is correct - S-E-P-A-R-A-T-E. Remember: there is A RAT in sepaRATE.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to do well in school?
explanation: Succeed is correct - S-U-C-C-E-E-D. Succeed has double C and double E.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a person you know?
explanation: Acquaintance is correct - A-C-Q-U-A-I-N-T-A-N-C-E. Acquaintance has a silent C after the Q.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very bad?
explanation: Weird is correct - W-E-I-R-D. Weird is an exception to the i before e rule.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning something that is done again?
explanation: Repetition is correct - R-E-P-E-T-I-T-I-O-N. Repetition means the action of repeating something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning something that is correct?
explanation: Accurate is correct - A-C-C-U-R-A-T-E. Accurate has double C.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning not known?
explanation: Unknown is correct - U-N-K-N-O-W-N. Unknown has a silent K in the middle.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to think about seriously?
explanation: Consider is correct - C-O-N-S-I-D-E-R. Consider means to think carefully about something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning something that is allowed?
explanation: Permissible is correct - P-E-R-M-I-S-S-I-B-L-E. Permissible has double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a person who plays music?
explanation: Musician is correct - M-U-S-I-C-I-A-N. Musician ends with -cian not -tion.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning something very important?
explanation: Necessary is correct - N-E-C-E-S-S-A-R-Y. Necessary has one C and double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a list of items?
explanation: Calendar is correct - C-A-L-E-N-D-A-R. Calendar ends in -ar not -er.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a large group of people?
explanation: Audience is correct - A-U-D-I-E-N-C-E. Audience refers to a group of people watching or listening.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to take part in?
explanation: Participate is correct - P-A-R-T-I-C-I-P-A-T-E. Participate means to take part in an activity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a prize or honor?
explanation: Reward is correct - R-E-W-A-R-D. A reward is something given in return for good behavior or effort.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to get smaller?
explanation: Shrink is correct - S-H-R-I-N-K. Shrink means to become or make smaller.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to go across?
explanation: Traverse is correct - T-R-A-V-E-R-S-E. Traverse means to travel across or through.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very interested?
explanation: Enthused is correct - E-N-T-H-U-S-E-D. Enthused means filled with enthusiasm or interest.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very clear?
explanation: Transparent is correct - T-R-A-N-S-P-A-R-E-N-T. Transparent means allowing light to pass through.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning connected to the subject?
explanation: Relevant is correct - R-E-L-E-V-A-N-T. Relevant means closely connected or appropriate to the matter at hand.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning something not essential?
explanation: Unnecessary is correct - U-N-N-E-C-E-S-S-A-R-Y. Unnecessary means not needed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a beginning?
explanation: Commencement is correct - C-O-M-M-E-N-C-E-M-E-N-T. Commencement means a beginning or the ceremony marking completion of studies.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning something that is always the same?
explanation: Consistent is correct - C-O-N-S-I-S-T-E-N-T. Consistent means acting or done in the same way over time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to make something better?
explanation: Ameliorate is correct - A-M-E-L-I-O-R-A-T-E. Ameliorate means to make something bad or unsatisfactory better.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to do at the same time?
explanation: Simultaneous is correct - S-I-M-U-L-T-A-N-E-O-U-S. Simultaneous means happening at the same time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to officially end?
explanation: Abolish is correct - A-B-O-L-I-S-H. Abolish means to formally put an end to something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very important to remember?
explanation: Memorable is correct - M-E-M-O-R-A-B-L-E. Memorable means worth remembering or easily remembered.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to make something bigger?
explanation: Expand is correct - E-X-P-A-N-D. Expand means to become or make larger.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning something everyone likes?
explanation: Popular is correct - P-O-P-U-L-A-R. Popular means liked or admired by many people.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning a study plan?
explanation: Curriculum is correct - C-U-R-R-I-C-U-L-U-M. Curriculum has double R and refers to subjects in a course of study.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very strange or unusual?
explanation: Peculiar is correct - P-E-C-U-L-I-A-R. Peculiar means strange or unusual.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning able to be done?
explanation: Feasible is correct - F-E-A-S-I-B-L-E. Feasible means possible and practical to do.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to come before?
explanation: Precede is correct - P-R-E-C-E-D-E. Precede means to come before something in time, order, or position.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to understand fully?
explanation: Comprehend is correct - C-O-M-P-R-E-H-E-N-D. Comprehend means to understand something fully.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to get better?
explanation: Improve is correct - I-M-P-R-O-V-E. Improve means to make or become better.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning in every place?
explanation: Everywhere is correct - E-V-E-R-Y-W-H-E-R-E. Everywhere means in all places.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning something that surprises you?
explanation: Surprise is correct - S-U-R-P-R-I-S-E. Surprise has two Rs.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to say again?
explanation: Repeat is correct - R-E-P-E-A-T. Repeat means to say or do something again.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning the day before today?
explanation: Yesterday is correct - Y-E-S-T-E-R-D-A-Y. Yesterday means the day before today.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning to look at?
explanation: Examine is correct - E-X-A-M-I-N-E. Examine means to inspect or look at closely.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning done many times?
explanation: Frequently is correct - F-R-E-Q-U-E-N-T-L-Y. Frequently means regularly or often.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning something that is very good?
explanation: Excellent is correct - E-X-C-E-L-L-E-N-T. Excellent has double L.
